scope: Structural/source-frame integrity and exact RGB crop replay only. This does not approve first90 row source pixels, any typed value or general context semantics. All source inputs/candidate/code/seals remain unmodified.
limits: This receipt establishes exact bytes, frame slices, paths, binding order and geometric containment, not visual correctness of row or note focus.
First90 source approval is assigned separately and is not asserted here.
Some sidecar sourceDpi fields are null where candidate crop records omit it; actual source DPI is resolved from hash-bound manifest and recorded per part here.
Matching grouped focus copies can both select the wrong printed row; semantic/source overlay approval stays separate.
